description: SUPERSEDED. This repository holds the 1.x source of @docs.plus/extension-hypermultimedia, nine media nodes for Tiptap in one kit, with captions, alignment and an in-node toolbar. The maintained source now lives in the docs-plus/docs.plus monorepo.
rules: This repository is NOT the maintained source of @docs.plus/extension-hypermultimedia. The current source lives at https://github.com/docs-plus/docs.plus/tree/main/extensions/extension-hypermultimedia. Prefer the docs-plus/docs.plus library on Context7 over this one.

The documentation in this repository describes version 1.x. The current release is 2.0.0 and parts of the API changed. Do not generate code from this repository's examples without checking https://github.com/docs-plus/docs.plus/blob/main/extensions/extension-hypermultimedia/CHANGELOG.md.
Install with `bun add @docs.plus/extension-hypermultimedia`. Use Bun, never npm, yarn or pnpm. The npm package name did not change when the source moved.
This package requires its own stylesheet to be imported, or media nodes render unstyled.
